Not to be nit-picky but technically the current aiel are offshoots of the tinkers who were once Diashan Aiel. the main difference being the tinkers still keep to the traditional beliefs instead of moving away from them.
:From a philosophical stand point, yes, the warrior Aiel are an offshoot of the Tuatha'an. From an etymological stand point, the Tuatha'an are an offshoot of the Diashan Aiel. Also, judging from Rand's trip through the glass columns, the lineage seems to support the Tuatha'an as the offshoot. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 00:14, January 5, 2012 (UTC)
